verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll/PEO product, so year-end W-2/1099 generation and distribution is a fair question. However, the evidence pack never mentions generating or distributing W-2s or 1099s. The nearby items cover W-4 data collection, recording fringe benefits, monthly payroll accuracy checks and contractor payment adjustments, none of which shows year-end tax form issuance.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have W-2s and 1099s generated and distributed to workers automatically at year-end
